decisions.reason: Correct: running another model does not prove the tested one was unloaded. The measurement now unloads the model on purpose, uses the room, waits, and judges the cold state by the times, leaving out a model whose cold call is as fast as its warm ones.

A registry entry is used by every command, so the option would have changed ordinary cards calls. Keep-alive is now an argument of one call and a config setting that only queue runs read, with a test that each other command passes exactly what it passed before.
Two entries may name the same server and model and share one loaded model. The queue now groups by the physical pair and keeps each call own entry options, with tests for both cases.
